items.name: charon_iapetus
items.direction: Two narrators audition for a premium documentary YouTube channel about money. Each reads the same passage on their own: calm, deep, intriguing and confident, at a measured pace, with a short pause before the final question. Leave a two-second silence between the two readings.
lines: In 1971, one TV announcement cut the last link between the dollar and gold. Since then, every dollar in your pocket has been backed by... a promise. So what are you really holding?
